::api-operation{method="GET" path="/v1/businesses/{biz}/products/{prod}/stats"}
#docs
MRR is each subscription's net MRR apportioned to its items by gross recurring amount, per currency.

## Path parameters

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `biz` | `string` | **yes** | Business id (biz_…) |
| `prod` | `string` | **yes** | The product's id (a slug id, e.g. `pro`). |

## Response

| Field | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `object` | `string` | The object type; always `product_stats`. One of `product_stats`. |
| `product` | `string` | The product's id (a slug id, e.g. `pro`). |
| `active_subscriptions` | `integer` | active + in_trial |
| `in_trial_subscriptions` | `integer` | Number of subscriptions in trial. |
| `mrr` | `array of object` | Monthly recurring revenue per currency, in minor units. |

## Status codes

| Status | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `200` | Success |
| `404` | No such product |

#request
```bash [Request]
curl "$TMBILLING_URL/v1/businesses/biz_XXXXXXXXXXXX01/products/pro/stats" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $TMBILLING_API_KEY"
```

#response

```json [200 OK]

  "object": "product_stats",
  "product": "pro",
  "active_subscriptions": 1,
  "in_trial_subscriptions": 1,
  "mrr": [
    {
      "currency": "USD",
      "amount_minor": 2900
    }
  ]
}
```
